rules.basis: The B4ZRKS sheet states 'Flow rate' as the one flow the pump is rated at, '450 GPM'; the Fleck flow-control parts print the same name for the flow a restrictor lets through and are out of scope.
The MES sheet heads its flow column 'Capacity', '63 GPM'; on the filter sheets the same name is gallons of service life, so the rule reads that sheet only.
The MA-240 HD sheet states the pressure limit under 'MAX. PSI' as a bare number in the unit the name carries.

The MA plunger pump sheets state 'Maximum Rated Power' in horsepower, '15.0 hp'; a cell that also prints the kilowatts, '144.0 hp 107.4 kW', is refused. 'Motor HP' prints fractions such as '4/10', which read as two figures, and is not read.

The Myers and Sta-Rite pump sheets state the motor in horsepower under 'Motor HP', 'HP' or 'Horsepower', as '1 HP', '1/2 HP' or a bare fraction such as '4/10' in a horsepower column; a fraction is one figure.

The SHEF42 sheet prints the pump's curve as one column per head, 'Capacity Gallons/Minute at 5 feet' to 'at 30 feet', bare figures in the gallons a minute the name carries; the head is read off the name, so each point keeps its height.
